caption: The drawing features a single human figure standing upright on a green and brown rock. The person is dressed in a garment made of what appears to be dark brown and gray fur, fringed with a yellowish trim along the edges. The clothing covers one shoulder and leaves the other bare, exposing the person's upper chest, arms, and lower legs. The person wears a necklace made up of white, tooth- or claw-shaped items and has a yellow headband, adorned with a feather that is white and gray. There are gold, circular earrings in both ears. One hand holds a pipe-like object, and the other holds a long, white knife or blade at midsection level. The figure has moccasin-style footwear in a beige or tan color, decorated with markings. The person appears to be looking slightly upward, with their right foot placed forward on the rock, suggesting a walking or climbing motion. The background is plain white or off-white with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Figurehead: Indian
